'''Crypt-ology''' is the per-person relationship-map layer of the [[MELEK Blockchain|MELEK]] ecosystem — the subsystem through which the [[Hathor (AI Witness)|Hathor]] witness keeps track of its relationship with each person it deals with, so that help, greetings and grants can be personal rather than generic.

The hyphenated spelling is deliberate. ''Cryptology'' in the scholarly sense means the study of codes and ancient writing; '''Crypt-ology''' is the ecosystem's own play on the word for its relationship-and-continuity layer. The two are kept distinct on purpose.

== What it is, and is not ==
* It '''is''' a relationship map: a per-account memory of prior interactions that lets the witness treat a returning person as someone it already knows.
* It is '''not''' the Temple. The Shaivite Temple is the operator's separate 501(c)(3) religious organisation; Crypt-ology is a software subsystem and should not be conflated with it.

== Status ==
The relationship map is partly built and extends an existing per-user relationship record. It is a supporting layer for the witness, not a standalone public product.
